jobs.occupation: Regional Sales Head / all genders / Part-fulltime (Sales-Manager/in)
jobs.description:
Work Your Magic with us!

Ready to explore, break barriers, and discover more? We know you’ve got big plans – so do we! Our colleagues across the globe love innovating with science and technology to enrich people’s lives with our solutions in Healthcare, Life Science, and Electronics. Together, we dream big and are passionate about caring for our rich mix of people, customers, patients, and planet. That's why we are always looking for curious minds that see themselves imagining the unimaginable with us.

Everything we do in Electronics is to help us deliver on our purpose of being the company behind the companies, advancing digital living. We are dedicated to being the trusted supplier of high-tech materials, services and specialty chemicals for the electronics, automotive and cosmetics industries. We foster a global collaborative organization made up of individuals who have the passion to win, obsess about the customer, are relentlessly curious and act with urgency. Together, we push the boundaries of science to make more possible for our customers.

Your role:

As Regional Sales Head Europe & USA, you will shape the commercial success of the region and help accelerate growth in the semiconductor industry. You will define and execute a clear regional go-to-market and sales strategy that wins new business and increases revenue. You will build, scale, and lead a high-performing sales organization by hiring, mentoring, and coaching regional account managers. With your leadership, the team will pursue ambitious targets while developing strong, lasting customer relationships. You will cultivate strategic partnerships with global key accounts and identify opportunities to drive further growth. You will manage complex sales cycles and oversee contract management from negotiation through execution. By tracking sales metrics and forecasting performance, you will turn data into decisive commercial action. You will report regional results and insights to executive leadership with clarity and confidence. Working closely with Marketing, Product Management, Customer Application, and Customer Fulfilment teams, you will align priorities and shared KPIs to deliver an excellent customer experience.

Who you are

- You have at least five years of sales experience in the semiconductor industry, ideally in a field such as lithography.
- You have at least two years of experience leading and managing a sales team.
- You have a strong track record of achieving revenue targets and winning new business.
- You are experienced in managing complex, long-cycle sales processes and strategic customer relationships.
- You bring strong leadership, coaching, negotiation, and presentation skills.
- You are confident using sales data, metrics, and forecasts to guide decisions and communicate performance.
- You collaborate effectively across Marketing, Product Management, Customer Application, and Customer Fulfilment teams.
- You are fluent in written and spoken English and German.

What we offer: We are curious minds that come from a broad range of backgrounds, perspectives, and life experiences. We believe that this variety drives excellence and innovation, strengthening our ability to lead in science and technology. We are committed to creating access and opportunities for all to develop and grow at your own pace. Join us in building a culture of inclusion and belonging that impacts millions and empowers everyone to work their magic and champion human progress!

Apply now and become a part of a team that is dedicated to Sparking Discovery and Elevating Humanity!

Are you a software developer who loves solving complex problems?

Do you love to lead international teams to solve complex problems and deliver exciting solutions?

Join our cutting-edge Software Development team

Our Digital Solutions provides intelligent, connected technologies to monitor and control our energy extraction assets. From the most advanced data collection technology to innovative software enabling remote collaboration, Waygate Technologies provides a full suite of non-destructive testing solutions and equipment including radiography, computed tomography, remote visual inspection, ultrasound, and eddy current products.

Partner with the best

As Developer Embedded Linux you will developing and maintaining Embedded Software for ARM/Linux platforms and systems in a client-server. You will collaborate with hardware engineers to ensure seamless integration between software and hardware components.

As an Developer Embedded Linux, you will be responsible for:

- Designing & implementation of embedded software for ultrasonic inspection devices based on TCP/IP for embedded Linux systems
- Implementing of user- and kernel space modules for hardware interaction including DMA drivers and Shared memory modules
- Designing and Implementing of result-data-servers with special focus to maximum data throughput
- Handling the interacting with common interfaces like I2C, Ethernet, WLAN, UART.
- Designing of efficient software and hardware interfaces using DMA transfers and kernel-mode drivers.
- Debugging, problem-solving and troubleshooting of embedded systems
- Releasing software including new features and bug fixes
- Participating in code reviews and provide constructive feedback to team members.

Fuel your passion

To be successful in this role you will:

- Have successfully completed your studies in Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering or a comparable field
- Have significant experience in Software Development
- Be familiar with C/C++ as well as common scripting languages programming (Python, Lua, Bash)
- Be familiar with software version control systems (git)
- Be self-contained, self-motivated, and have a structured approach to work
- Demonstrate good verbal and written communication in English

Work in a way that works for you

We recognize that everyone is different and that the way in which people want to work and deliver at their best is different for everyone too. In this role, we can offer the following flexible working patterns:

- Working flexible hours - flexing the times when you work in the day to help you fit everything in and work when you are the most productive

Working with us

Our people are at the heart of what we do at Baker Hughes. We know we are better when all of our people are developed, engaged and able to bring their whole authentic selves to work. We invest in the health and well-being of our workforce, train and reward talent and develop leaders at all levels to bring out the best in each other.

Working for you

Our inventions have revolutionized energy for over a century. But to keep going forward tomorrow, we know we have to push the boundaries today. We prioritize rewarding those who embrace change with a package that reflects how much we value their input. Join us, and you can expect:

- Contemporary work-life balance policies and wellbeing activities
- Comprehensive private medical care options
- Safety net of life insurance and disability programs
- Tailored financial programs

Applications from people with disabilities are expressly welcome. Severely disabled candidates will be given preference in the case of equal qualifications.

What you will do:

We need a highly motivated and skilled Senior Engineer in Software Test who is passionate about using modern software engineering and testing principles to deliver robust applications to our global users. The Senior Engineer will plan the schedule and manage test activities for features or projects as well as evaluate standards and special software. The Senior Engineer, Software Test may work with outsourced design partners, review and mentor less experienced engineers’ deliverables and have a holistic understanding of tests for modules, sub-systems, and the fully integrated system. This position will define, design, implement, and maintain engineering test equipment, test strategies, test software and specifications for sub-systems and complete software systems. This is a role responsible for carrying out various tasks to ensure our software test approaches are effectively and efficiently designed, implemented, and maintained for both legacy and new development.

Responsibilities:

- Proficient in software test methodologies, tools, and techniques.
- Collaborate with team members across product, architecture, development, DevOps, and testing teams in designing testing approaches.
- Collaborate with product management teams in an Agile/Scrum environment to develop a comprehensive set of tests.
- Able to provide in-depth analysis to resolve technical issues, anticipate risks and ensure timely management escalation
- Provide software test solutions for both functional and non-functional software quality.
- Drive test effort estimation, test planning and risk analysis activities for features or projects.
- Create manual/automation procedure and process documentation to enable end-users to successful operate system software.
- Design and develop test platforms for new and existing complex products from concept to implementation.
- Provide mentoring and trainings as needed
- Participate in the software technical design reviews to mentor less experienced engineers as well as reinforce best design practices.
- Optimize, improve & maintain best test process and practices
- Liaise between less experienced Engineers and Staff and above Engineers.
- Ensure all quality assurance and testing activities are conducted throughout the software life cycle and that the results are documented per the Quality Management System.

What you need:

- B.S. of Engineering in software engineering/computer science or related discipline with 3 or more years of software testing experience
- Strong verbal and written communication skills in English
- Knowledge of regulatory standards applicable to medical device and software development life cycle: 21 CFR part 820, ISO 13485, ISO 14971, and IEC 62304.
- Knowledge of Python.
- Demonstrated experience in software testing, both manual and automated testing.
- Demonstrated experience in the following: test strategy, test case development, software testing methods, software risk analysis across the complete system and software development practices.
- Demonstrated experience in influencing cross-functional teams beyond own group (Process/Project Stakeholder)
- Demonstrated experience in identifying process gaps and implementing improvements in respected zones and correct/improve processes
- Demonstrated experience in proposing solutions rather than problems

Who we want:

- Dedicated achievers. People who thrive in a fast-paced environment and will stop at nothing to ensure a project is complete and meets regulations and expectations.
- User-focused creators. Engineers who design with the user in mind, developing software that helps change patients’ lives.
- Teammates. Partners who listen to ideas, share thoughts and work together to move the business forward.
- Analytical problem solvers. People who go beyond just fixing to identify root causes, evaluate optimal solutions, and recommend comprehensive upgrades to prevent future issues
- Goal-oriented developers. Keeping the customer and requirements squarely in focus, people who deliver safe and robust solutions.

jobs.employer_name: Proteome Sciences R&D GmbH & Co KG
jobs.description:
Proteome Sciences plc (www.proteomics.com) is a global leader in applied proteomics with scientific operations based in Frankfurt am Main (Germany) and San Diego (CA, USA). We partner with innovative companies and academic research groups and offer high sensitivity, proprietary technologies for protein and peptide biomarker discovery, validation and assay development.

We are looking for an exceptionally qualified and highly motivated
(Senior) Mass Spectrometry Specialist (m/f/d)
to join our Mass Spectrometry team based on our ISO9001:2015 certified & GCLP accredited facility at Proteome Sciences R&D GmbH & Co. KG in Frankfurt am Main.

In this role, you will serve as the core technical anchor and operational subject matter expert for our Mass Spectrometry laboratory. You will combine deep technical expertise in LC-MS instrumentation and quantitative proteomics with strong project management, workflow optimization, and technical coordination responsibilities, driving technical excellence across client projects.
Independent operation, calibration, routine maintenance, and advanced troubleshooting of mass spectrometry and liquid chromatography (nano-LC) equipment.
Development, optimization, and execution of quantitative LC-MS methods (including TMT, DIA, DDA, and targeted studies) for client projects and R&D.
Diligent tracking and initial quality control of MS raw data in close interaction with the Bioinformatics and wet-lab team.
Technical consulting and contribution to client communications, including project proposals, data presentations, and technical reports.
Guidance and technical support for laboratory personnel to maintain high operational standards and best laboratory practices.
Ensuring strict compliance of MS procedures with ISO9001:2015 and GCLP requirements.

Experience in a professional industrial environment (Masters: 5+ years, Bachelors: 10+ years or equivalent combination of vocation training and experience), preferably within a CRO environment, operating & maintaining HRLC-MS systems analyzing biological matricies for large molecules.
Strong hands-on experience and deep technical knowledge of nano LC and Orbitrap MS including advanced instrument operation and troubleshooting is a requirement.
Preferred experience will include a solid understanding of quantitative MS techniques (e.g., TMT, DIA, DDA, PRM) applied to peptides and proteins,
Exceptional candidates will possess a knowledge of proteomic data processing software (e.g., Proteome Discoverer, Skyline, DIA-NN)
Robust project coordination, time management, and organizational skills.
Excellent technical documentation skills and readiness to contribute to client reports and presentations.
Clear and proficient communication in written and spoken English.

Advantageous for the role:

First exposure to technical leadership, mentoring junior team members, or managing project workflows.
Working knowledge or fluency in German.
Familiarity with quality management requirements (ISO 9001, GxP).
Practical knowledge of programming and/or scripting tools such as Python and R.

A high-impact technical role at a market leading company in applied proteomics and biomarker discovery.
Challenging projects in collaboration with international pharma, biotech, and academic leaders.
A friendly, welcoming working atmosphere and support for professional development.

The Max Planck Institute for Multidisciplinary Sciences is a leading international research institute with exceptional scientific breadth, where scientists from physics, chemistry, biology, medicine, and computer science collaborate to uncover fundamental life processes. With more than 40 research groups and about 1,000 employees from over 66 nations, we offer an inspiring, international research environment.

The Department of Theoretical and Computational Biophysics headed by Helmut Grubmüller is inviting applications for a PhD Student in the field of

Theory and Methods for Non-equilibrium Theory and Atomistic Simulations of Complex Biomolecules Possible projects are variational free energy methods, thermodynamics of solvation shells, constant-pH simulation methods, Markovian thermodynamics, as well as functional mechanisms of the ribosome, fatty acid synthase, CRISPR/Cas, or intrinsically disordered proteins.

Please indicate in your application which of the above listed projects is most intriguing for you. Eligible candidates have strong skills in computational molecular (bio)physics, statistical mechanics, scientific computing and also a keen interest in interdisciplinary research and collaboration with experimental groups.

You hold (or expect to complete soon) a Master’s or equivalent degree in physics, mathematics or any related field; correspondingly.
State of the art on-site high performance/GPU compute facilities
Competitive research in an inspiring, world-class environment
A wide range of offers to help you balance work and family life
Further training opportunities and free in-house language courses

The group language is English, so no German language skills are required - but it is a great opportunity for you to learn German! The historic city of Göttingen, located in the heart of Germany, offers great outdoors and cultural opportunities, a vibrant student scene, and an impressive scientific heritage.

You will have the opportunity to participate in one of several available PhD programs, with three years funding, in collaboration with the University of Göttingen. Master’s students aiming at a fast-track PhD are also welcome. Payment and benefits are based on the German Public Service Payscale (TVöD Bund) guidelines. We would like to fill the position as soon as possible, but the exact start date is flexible.

The Max Planck Society is committed to increasing the number of individuals with disabilities in its workforce and, therefore, encourages applications from such qualified individuals. The Max Planck Society strives for diversity and gender equality and welcomes applications from all backgrounds.

jobs.occupation: Customs & Trade Manager Luxury (all genders) (Leiter/in - Export)
jobs.description:
Your Tasks

Our Corporate Customs & Trade department is responsible for ensuring compliant and efficient cross-border trade activities across Beiersdorf globally. To strengthen our support for the Luxury business, we are looking for a Customs & Trade Manager Luxury who will act as the key business partner for our Luxury brands LaPrairie and Chantecaille and drive the integration of customs and trade processes into our global operating model.

Your main responsibilities will include:

- Act as the dedicated Customs & Trade business partner for our Luxury brands and support international business activities, cross-border trade activities and strategic business initiatives from a customs and trade compliance perspective.
- Ensure compliance with applicable international, European and national customs, export control and trade regulations, including sanctions and embargo requirements.
- Assess new business models, supply chain structures, distribution channels and strategic initiatives with regard to customs and trade implications, risks and opportunities.
- Drive the implementation, harmonization and continuous improvement of customs and trade processes, controls and governance standards across the Luxury business in alignment with global Beiersdorf requirements.
- Support the integration of Luxury entities, systems and operating models into Beiersdorf's global Customs & Trade framework.
- Collaborate closely with Supply Chain, Logistics, Procurement, Finance, Tax, Legal and Commercial teams to ensure compliant and efficient trade flows.
- Define and implement customs and trade requirements within business processes, IT systems and master data structures, including SAP GTS
Monitor regulatory developments and translate legal requirements into practical and business-oriented solutions.
- Deliver training and advisory support to internal stakeholders and promote customs and trade awareness across the organization.
Manage and support customs and trade-related projects at global and regional level.

Your Profile

- University degree in Customs, International Trade, Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, Law or a related field.
- Several years of professional experience in customs, international trade, export control or global trade compliance, gained in an international corporate, consulting or public sector environment.
- Strong understanding of customs regulations, international trade requirements/compliance and supply chain processes, ideally with exposure to luxury, consumer goods or FMCG businesses.
- Experience in process harmonization, transformation projects and cross-functional project management.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills combined with a pragmatic and business-oriented mindset.
- Ability to work independently and manage complex topics in an international environment.
- Experience with SAP and ideally SAP GTS.
- Excellent communication and presentation skills.
- Fluent English required; German is considered an advantage.

At Beiersdorf, we want to help people feel good about their skin – and our commitment goes far beyond caring for skin. For 140 years, we have developed innovative skin and body care products for well-known brands such as NIVEA, Eucerin, La Prairie, Hansaplast, and Labello. We act according to our purpose, WE CARE BEYOND SKIN, and take responsibility for our consumers, our employees, the environment and society.

Behind every brand, every product and every accomplishment are our more than 20,000 employees. It is for them that we live an inclusive culture of respect and trust that is strongly aligned with our values – CARE, COURAGE, SIMPLICITY and TRUST. We also embrace diversity by valuing the uniqueness of each individual and being committed to equal opportunities for all.

Additional information

If you have any questions, please check our application FAQ first. If your question is not answered there, feel free to contact our Talent Acquisition team via rc@beiersdorf.com (rc@beiersdorf.com) .

Work Your Magic with us!

Ready to explore, break barriers, and discover more? We know you’ve got big plans – so do we! Our colleagues across the globe love innovating with science and technology to enrich people’s lives with our solutions in Healthcare, Life Science, and Electronics. Together, we dream big and are passionate about caring for our rich mix of people, customers, patients, and planet. That's why we are always looking for curious minds that see themselves imagining the unimaginable with us.

Your role
As a Global Category Manager for Site Services, you will sit at the heart of a worldwide Technical Sourcing organization, shaping the procurement strategies that underpin some of the most significant capital and operational investments across a global science and technology enterprise. This is a high-
visibility, high-impact role for an experienced procurement professional who thrives on complexity, drives value at scale, and influences outcomes across organizational boundaries without relying on direct authority.
You will own and continuously evolve the global category strategy for Site Services – spanning Equipment and Components, Construction, and Energy – directly aligned to capital investment plans and long-term business priorities. Applying a spend entrepreneurship mindset, you will lead rigorous end-to-end sourcing programs: from market analysis, supplier segmentation, and total cost of ownership modeling through to contract conclusion and claim management.
You will build and govern a high-performing strategic supplier portfolio, establish structured supplier relationship management programs with clear key performance indicator frameworks and governance cadences, and ensure resilient, multi-region supply continuity. Acting as a trusted counterpart to
Manufacturing, Engineering, Operations, Finance, Legal, and Compliance stakeholders across all business sectors, you will coordinate virtual global category teams across the Americas, Europe, and Asia – generating cross- project synergies and delivering quantifiable, sustained value improvements with full transparency to senior leadership

Who you are
• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Economics, Supply Chain Management, Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field; equivalent professional experience is equally valued.
• 8–12+ years of progressive experience in strategic sourcing and category management, with a strong track record in indirect, technical, or engineering-related procurement within complex, multinational environments – ideally in life sciences, healthcare, or electronics.
• Demonstrated expertise in developing and executing global category strategies, including capital expenditure and operational expenditure procurement, supplier relationship management, contract negotiations, and multi-region supplier governance.
• Exceptional analytical and commercial acumen: fluency in total cost of ownership modeling, spend analytics, should-cost analysis, and advanced negotiation strategies, with the ability to translate technical requirements into compelling procurement solutions.
• Outstanding stakeholder management and influencing skills; proven ability to lead without formal authority in a matrixed global organization and to present data-driven business cases to senior leadership.
• Solid understanding of compliance-intensive environments, including Good Manufacturing Practice standards and sustainable procurement practices aligned to environmental, social, and governance principles.
• Demonstrated ability to engage with artificial intelligence tools and concepts – including their practical applications, limitations, and ethical implications – to support informed, responsible decision-making in a procurement context.
• Business fluency in English is required; proficiency in German, French, Mandarin, or other languages is a distinct advantage.

What we offer: We are curious minds that come from a broad range of backgrounds, perspectives, and life experiences. We believe that this variety drives excellence and innovation, strengthening our ability to lead in science and technology. We are committed to creating access and opportunities for all to develop and grow at your own pace. Join us in building a culture of inclusion and belonging that impacts millions and empowers everyone to work their magic and champion human progress!

Apply now and become a part of a team that is dedicated to Sparking Discovery and Elevating Humanity!

LIVE THE CABIN CREW LIFE

Join our team as Emirates cabin crew and see the world as you work. This is your opportunity to be part of the world’s largest international airline.

Look forward to a tax-free salary, free accommodation and great travel perks for you and your family. Make Dubai your home and enjoy all the benefits of this vibrant city.

If you’re ready for a career that takes you places, apply online now and start your adventure with Emirates

WE ARE LOOKING FOR:

• At least 1 year of hospitality or customer service experience

• Positive attitude with the natural ability to provide excellent service in a team environment, dealing with people from many cultures

• A minimum of high school (Grade 12) education

• Fluent in written and spoken English (additional languages are an advantage)

• Arm reach of 212 cm while standing on tiptoes and minimum height of 160 cm which will enable you to reach emergency equipment on all aircraft types

• No visible tattoos while you’re in Emirates cabin crew uniform (cosmetic and bandage coverings are not allowed)

• Can adapt to new people, new places and new situations

• As an Emirates cabin crew, you will be based in Dubai and will need to meet the UAE’s employment visa requirements

• At least 21 years old

MORE INFORMATION

Visit

https://www.emiratesgroupcareers.com/cabin-crew

for details of our walk-in recruitment days and how to apply.

Work Your Magic with us!

Ready to explore, break barriers, and discover more? We know you’ve got big plans – so do we! Our colleagues across the globe love innovating with science and technology to enrich people’s lives with our solutions in Healthcare, Life Science, and Electronics. Together, we dream big and are passionate about caring for our rich mix of people, customers, patients, and planet. That's why we are always looking for curious minds that see themselves imagining the unimaginable with us.

Your Role

As a Principal Scientist in the Structural Biology and Biophysics team, R&D Discovery, you will provide scientific leadership in interdisciplinary projects to elucidate structural mode of action and enable structure-based design with a focus on macromolecular complexes of antibodies, multispecifics and molecular degraders. You will strengthen our X-ray crystallography capabilities and, where possible complement our cryo-EM workflows to establish integrated, end-to-end experimental strategies for structural enablement — spanning protein and sample generation, data acquisition, and structural model building. You coordinate CRO/collaboration partner activities for reagents and data generation and drive innovations in structural biology. You clearly explain and communicate scientific findings and proposals to cross-functional teams and stakeholders to support informed and fast decision-making. You will mentor and develop junior scientists in structure biology and drug discovery contributing to a high-performing, collaborative culture.

Who You Are

- PhD in Structural Biology or a related field with 10+ years of relevant experience (including biopharma, biotech) and strong track record to design, execute and drive complex structural biology projects.
- Deep expertise in high-resolution structure determination of proteins and protein complexes by Xray crystallography (sample generation, data collection & processing, structure refinement with industry-standard software).
- Experience working with antigen–antibody and protein degrader complexes, with a deep understanding of structure–function relationships.
- Ideally hands-on with single-particle cryo-EM and biophysical (e.g. HDX-MS, SAXS; Refeyn, FIDA, DSF)
- Experience with cloud-based/HPC data management and processing; LINUX scripting; AI/ML-based prediction of biomolecular structures.
- Effective collaborator and leader in multidisciplinary settings with excellent English communication; skilled in guiding/mentoring scientists, coordinating multi-site work, and managing CROs to balance project demands.
- Proven ability to convey complex data clearly to drive decisions; strong publication history or impactful drug discovery contributions (oncology/immunology/neuroscience favored); excellent problem-solving abilities and experience introducing relevant new technologies.

What we offer: We are curious minds that come from a broad range of backgrounds, perspectives, and life experiences. We believe that this variety drives excellence and innovation, strengthening our ability to lead in science and technology. We are committed to creating access and opportunities for all to develop and grow at your own pace. Join us in building a culture of inclusion and belonging that impacts millions and empowers everyone to work their magic and champion human progress!

For our division Global IT at the headquarter in Wiesbaden (Germany) we are looking for you as soon as possible.

What you can expect:

- Being part of our Infrastructure & Network Team in an international IT set-up
- Group-wide definition of standards for network technology
- Management of external service providers
- Establishment  of security standards in collaboration with the Information Security Officer
- Hosting and connection of production-related systems
- Service responsibility mobile telephony as well as Internet connections
- Responsibility for identity and access management (AD)

What we expect:

- Degree in computer science, electrical engineering or comparable education and work experience
- Minimum experience of 3-5 years in the field of Infrastructure & Network (e.g., SDWAN, VPN, WAN, LAN, Internet, firewall)
- Deep Knowledge in data centers, (local) servers, virtualization (VMWare) and storage (NAS),
- Open-Minded according to Infrastructure-as-a-Service (IaaS)
- Service-oriented and user-centered mindset
- Strong analytical skills, ability to communicate topics to senior management
- Professional in English and German

This is your new job:
Tasks:

ssMOS Industrial Engineer responsible for production capacity modeling and product yield engineering

Capacity modeling and reporting with focus on Back-End

Interface with Back-End T&O for ssMOS products

Interface with ssMOS Marketing, Commercial Marketing, Product Mgt for strategic planning including capacity and capex according to ssMOS LTP and industrial roadmap 

Interface with Logistics to identify capacity (tool and material) bottlenecks on package level and align mitigation plan with T&O (back-end) to ensure no supply shortage

Support yield engineering team for material disposition on front, mid and back-end

Identify capacity (tool, material) and yield improvements on package and product level for ssMOS

Participate to cross functional task force teams representing ssMOS industrial

This is you:
3 to 5 Years experience working in technical positions, preferrably on MOSFETs

Knowledge of capacity modeling on semiconductor back-end including assembly tool and material

Knowledge of wafer and final test yield data analysis

Knowledge of Semiconductor Mid and Back-end technologies

Expert level on data management using MS Excel, SAP, O9 or similar.

Strong analytical and communication skills

Passion and interest in data analysis with big amount of data and ability to convert them in information

Open minded and capable to think “out of the box”, eager to learn and accept new challenges

Capable of interacting in multicultural and multisite environment

Fluent in written and spoken English. German language knowledge is a plus.

About the role

As Process Engineer Lithography, you will be responsible for ensuring stable, capable, and reproducible lithography processes in a high-volume semiconductor manufacturing environment. You will drive process improvements, solve complex technical challenges, support the introduction of new technologies, and work closely with production, maintenance, quality, and development teams to achieve excellence in safety, quality, productivity, and cost performance.

This is your new role

- Ensure stable, capable, and reproducible lithography processes in daily semiconductor manufacturing operations
- Monitor and improve process performance using SPC, process capability indicators, and manufacturing data analysis
- Investigate process deviations, non-conforming lots, and yield excursions and drive sustainable corrective actions
- Identify process-related quality issues and support continuous yield and defect reduction initiatives
- Support root-cause analysis activities using structured problem-solving methodologies such as 5Why and 8D
- Define, execute, analyze, and document experiments to improve process capability, productivity, quality, and cost performance
- Support qualification, release, and implementation of new processes, materials, and equipment
- Contribute to process change management, industrialization projects, and technology transfers into production
- Create and maintain process documentation, work instructions, OCAPs, specifications, and training materials
- Conduct technical training and knowledge sharing for production teams
- Participate in FMEA activities and support risk assessment and mitigation measures

This is you

- University degree in Physics, Chemistry, Electrical Engineering, Materials Science, Microsystems Engineering, or a comparable technical discipline
- First professional experience in semiconductor manufacturing, process engineering, or a comparable high-tech production environment is advantageous
- Knowledge of lithography processes and semiconductor manufacturing technologies is desirable
- Strong analytical thinking skills combined with a structured and systematic working approach
- Passion for solving technical problems and driving continuous improvement
- Ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities in a dynamic manufacturing environment
- Strong communication and teamwork skills
- High level of ownership, initiative, and accountability
- Practical mindset combined with attention to detail and quality orientation
- Good German and English communication skills, both written and spoken

jobs.occupation: Working Student (d/f/m) as Software Development Assistant (Ingenieur/in - Luft- und Raumfahrttechnik)
jobs.description:
About us

Airbus pioneers sustainable aerospace for a safe and united world. The Company constantly innovates to provide efficient and technologically-advanced solutions in aerospace, defence, and connected services. In commercial aircraft, Airbus offers modern and fuel-efficient airliners and associated services. Airbus is also a European leader in defence and security and one of the world's leading space businesses. In helicopters, Airbus provides the most efficient civil and military rotorcraft solutions and services worldwide.
Job description

In order to support the Project and Product Management Department, Airbus Operations is looking for a

Working Student (d/f/m) as Software Development Assistant

You are a full time student (d/f/m), looking for a working student position and want to get to know the work of an Software Development Assistant (d/f/m). Then apply now! We look forward to you supporting us in the Project and Product Management Department as a working student (d/f/m) with approx. 18 hours a week!

- Location: Buxtehude
- Start: 01.12.2026
- Duration:  12 months (Extension possible for 1 more year)

You will receive a collectively agreed salary of at least €18.53 per hour, depending on the job. There are also special payments such as vacation pay.

Definition working student

Working students are students who are enrolled at a University or some other institution of higher education, and who are employed in a reasonably long, fixed-term position parallel to their studies. This position must not be confused with an internship or with the possibility of writing a final thesis.

This employment usually takes place directly on the company's premises. A working student's main focus remains on their studies, which is why, during term-time, working students are not allowed to work more than 20 hours per week.

Working students therefore usually work near their place of study, so as to conveniently combine studying and employment.

Your location

Buxtehude - a picturesque town in direct proximity to Hamburg with direct public transport connection - accommodates Airbus Cabin Electronics. We are responsible for the end-to-end value chain of the cabin management and connectivity solutions for all Airbus aircraft: In every Airbus cabin beats a heart from Buxtehude. We offer a unique opportunity for direct collaboration across all disciplines in order to deliver an innovative high-tech portfolio for passenger comfort, aircraft safety and connectivity. Imagine the possibilities!

Your benefits

- Attractive salary and work-life balance with an 18-hour week (flexitime).
- A final thesis is possible after consultation with the department.
- International environment with the opportunity to network globally.
- Work with modern/diversified technologies.
- Opportunity to participate in the Generation Airbus Community to expand your own network.

Your tasks and responsibilities

- Accelerate engineering efficiency with AI Prototypes (POCs) that optimize / assist development teams using applicable and available AI frameworks
- Contribute to project work, potentially including coding, testing or SW integration.
- Contribute to organizational support by addressing backlog maintenance for Scrum teams, scripting Jira automations, creating & maintaining dashboards, etc.
- Assist in data collection, analysis, and preparation of reports and presentations.
- Preparation and reporting of Project Status to various stakeholders.
- Conduct research and gather information on specific topics as required.
- Perform other ad-hoc duties as assigned by the supervisor.

Desired skills and qualifications

- Enrolled full-time student (d/f/m) in a relevant field of study (e.g., Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Science, Electronics Engineering,, or related disciplines).
- Programming and Scripting abilities along with previous practical experience is mandatory.
- A strong aptitude for operationalizing AI to enhance daily productivity.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
- Proficient in Google Suite (Docs, Slides, Sheets, AppSheet, Gemini, etc).
- Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, in English, is mandatory; and German would be a plus.
- Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
- High level of motivation, proactivity, and willingness to learn.

Please upload the following documents: cover letter, CV, relevant transcripts, enrollment certificate.

Not a 100% match? No worries! Airbus supports your personal growth.

Take your career to a new level and apply online (https://www.airbus.com/en/careers) now!

This job requires an awareness of any potential compliance risks and a commitment to act with integrity, as the foundation for the Company’s success, reputation and sustainable growth

By submitting your CV or application you are consenting to Airbus using and storing information about you for monitoring purposes relating to your application or future employment. This information will only be used by Airbus.
Airbus is committed to achieving workforce diversity and creating an inclusive working environment. We welcome all applications irrespective of social and cultural background, age, gender, disability, sexual orientation or religious belief.

At Airbus, we support you to work, connect and collaborate more easily and flexibly. Wherever possible, we foster flexible working arrangements to stimulate innovative thinking.

jobs.description:
International Project Manager

We are expanding our team and are looking for a proactive, dynamic** Project Manager** who wants to join a creative and motivated team of Project Managers. Our Project Managers should be team players with a strong service provider and leadership attitude. We are looking for people who love to work with modern software, to solve problems and who are willing to learn continuously. In this context, we are looking for a candidate who understands the importance of the following:

- Taking responsibility for steering the clinical studies through all expected and unexpected milestones
- keep the oversight of study risks, budget, timelines, vendors and streamline the work and results of international teams
- Having the confidence to present study status, issues and solution in front of clients
- Being able to think outside the box and finding creative solutions

 Your profile:

- At least 3-5 years of experience in clinical research, preferably in a CRO
- Excellent communication and self-management skills
- Business fluent level in spoken and written English (and German preferred).
- Experience in Project Management or taking over Project Leadership
- Englisch C1 required

 We offer:

- An independent, diverse and interesting area of responsibilities and an excellent working environment
- A dynamic team which likes to work together with passionate people who enjoy valuable work
- A young company culture and management, with a clear path to personal development and the opportunity to take responsibility not only within projects, but also within the company
- Flexible working hours with the possibility for home office
- A CRO caring to enable investigator initiated research by taking over sponsorship

Interested? An extremely innovative company is waiting for you. The salary will depend on your experience, performance, and value you will bring to our clients. If you are interested, send us your application to: hr@gcp-service.com
